topics.name: Canonical Closure Set Readiness
topics.purpose: Define readiness evaluation for a coherent group/kernel/domain of contracts including dependency/reference closure rather than assessing every file only in isolation.

semantics.identity_rule: Each closure-set evaluation has an explicit identity.
semantics.member_rule: Closure-set member contracts are exact refs.
semantics.dependency_rule: Required external dependencies are exact refs and validation state.
semantics.member_status_rule: Required member readiness states are explicit.
semantics.locking_rule: Closure-set ready does not silently lock members; lock transitions remain explicit.
semantics.authority_rule: Closure readiness grants no runtime authority.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.

hard_gates.condition: all files individually valid means closure automatically complete

references.purpose: Closure sets evaluate profile criteria collectively.
